products.name: Necklace, 18K Gold Plated Steel
products.description:
HANEEN KARMANJI Necklace


A delicate and elegant necklace designed to add a soft luxury touch to your everyday style.


Details:

Material: Stainless steel with gold plating

Closure Type: Lobster claw

Stone: Cubic zirconia

Necklace Length: 41 + 5 cm extension

Pendant Size: 1.5 × 1.3 cm

Weight: 3 g


Crafted to be waterproof, hypoallergenic, and comfortable for daily wear. The gold plating is designed to stay beautiful, with long-lasting shine and tarnish-resistant quality.
products.short_description: Elegant HANEEN KARMANJI necklace in gold-plated stainless steel with cubic zirconia. Waterproof, hypoallergenic, and tarnish-resistant for everyday wear.
